name: Joshua Rotenberg
body: I've sat on every side of an Apollo deal: as the rep using the tool, as the seller of a complex GTM platform, and as the person wiring it into the stack. At Accelo I ran discovery and scoped CRM and project-management deals with C-suite buyers, ranked top three on the team while quota roughly doubled, and built the implementation plans the delivery team executed. I know where a deal stalls when the technical answer isn't ready.

Today I design GTM systems end to end. I architect HubSpot, Salesforce, and GoHighLevel environments, integrate them through REST APIs, webhooks, Zapier, Make, and n8n, and build AI-driven prospecting workflows that call the OpenAI and Claude APIs to score accounts and personalize outreach. I've used Apollo, Salesloft, ZoomInfo, and Gong hands-on, so customer conversations about the stack start from experience, not a datasheet.

My title history is sales and implementation rather than solutions consulting, and running formal POCs at Apollo's scale would be where I'd grow fastest. I'd welcome a conversation at 303-726-5037 or jrotnbrg@gmail.com.
